image:image.image:title: Haskish is designed for teaching the AQA Functional Programming topic. It implements a subset of the Haskell language with full specification coverage, and requires no installation or user accounts.
image:image.image:caption: Haskish is designed for teaching the AQA Functional Programming topic. It implements a subset of the Haskell language with full specification coverage, and requires no installation or user accounts.

image:image.image:title: Haskish provides an interactive REPL (Read-Eval-Print Loop) for experimenting with Haskell code. It supports multi-line input, syntax highlighting, and displays results in a clear format.
image:image.image:caption: Haskish provides an interactive REPL (Read-Eval-Print Loop) for experimenting with Haskell code. It supports multi-line input, syntax highlighting, and displays results in a clear format.

image:image.image:title: Haskish includes 15 comprehensive lessons covering the AQA Functional Programming specification. Each lesson includes explanations, examples, and exercises to reinforce learning. There are further challenges for each exercise to challenge the most able students.
image:image.image:caption: Haskish includes 15 comprehensive lessons covering the AQA Functional Programming specification. Each lesson includes explanations, examples, and exercises to reinforce learning. There are further challenges for each exercise to challenge the most able students.

image:image.image:caption: Haskish supports partial function application, allowing functions to be applied to some of their arguments, returning new functions that take the remaining arguments.

image:image.image:title: Haskish supports higher-order functions, allowing functions to be passed as arguments and returned as results.

image:image.image:title: Chewring is a Turing machine simulator for A-level Computer Science, designed for classroom demonstrations and for students building their own machines and completing student tasks through an intuitive interface.

image:image.image:title: Chewring provides a visual representation of the finite state diagram, helping you understand the structure and transitions of your Turing machine.
image:image.image:caption: Chewring provides a visual representation of the finite state diagram, helping you understand the structure and transitions of your Turing machine.

image:image.image:title: Chewring allows you to step through the execution of your Turing machine, observing the changes in the tape and the current state.
image:image.image:caption: Chewring allows you to step through the execution of your Turing machine, observing the changes in the tape and the current state.

image:image.image:title: Chewring provides example Turing machines to help you get started quickly.
image:image.image:caption: Chewring provides example Turing machines to help you get started quickly.

image:image.image:title: Chewring has built-in student tasks that you can complete to practice your understanding of Turing machines.
image:image.image:caption: Chewring has built-in student tasks that you can complete to practice your understanding of Turing machines.
